description: Update the shelf stock of a product or of one of its variants. Operational change (§4.6): any rikma member may do it, it applies at once, and prices are never touched. Two modes: `set` counts the shelf ("there are 7"), `add` adds a delivery ("12 came in"), reading the quantity on the server first so a sale that landed meanwhile is not overwritten. Use quant=-1 for unlimited. A product that is sold by variant keeps its stock on the variants (Matanot.quant is not used). Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#setShopStockTool

value.description: Units: the new count (`set`) or how many came in (`add`). Ignored when unlimited=true.

variantId.description: Variant id (from listRikmaProductVariants or listRikmaProducts). Required when the product has variants. Pass null/omit for a simple product.

name: setShopStockTool
